scoring_justification: The model is an analytical deterministic expression; the checker can recompute the expected output using the same equations and parameters, comparing each row's predicted values to the agent's submitted CSV via mean absolute error (MAE).

outputs.description: CSV file with three columns containing the computed elastic modulus and tensile strength for each CNT volume fraction. The checker recomputes the same analytical model and compares row-wise values.

output_contract.notes: The model uses deterministic analytical expressions; no randomness. The checker will recompute the expected values using the same formulas and parameters, comparing each cell with an absolute tolerance.

steps.description: Recompute expected E_modulus and Tensile_strength from V_CNT using the given model parameters and compare with the agent's submitted values. Score based on mean absolute error (MAE) across all predicted points; full credit when MAE ≈ 0, degrading linearly to zero at MAE >= 0.1.
